task: Choose the audience and intended action
completion_evidence: Brief names the audience, desired action and success measure.

task: Choose the activation route and verify rights
completion_evidence: Select an existing event, an authorized VNV experience partnership or a brand-owned event. Host confirms access, inventory and permitted benefits.

task: Approve the experience and responsibility split
completion_evidence: Signed scope differentiates paid sponsorship rights, activation management and direct costs; overlapping management work assigned once.
Approved visitor journey, permitted claims, artwork, consent language, and recipient for authorized leads.

task: Book suppliers and confirm fabrication inputs
completion_evidence: Selected vendor confirms files, dimensions, lead time, venue restrictions, install and collection windows.
Host script, shifts, live demonstration, opt-in handoff, fallback and measurement method tested.
Organizer sign-off covers access, load-in, service points, staffing and strike.

task: Install and run a visitor test
completion_evidence: Build matches approved art and footprint; sample visitor completes the agreed action.

task: Run interactions and daily results check
completion_evidence: Hosts log agreed interactions and authorized contacts, with issues and adjustments owned.
Brand and organizer receive fulfillment, agreed metrics, authorized follow-up records and cost reconciliation.

task: Agree next action with the decision maker
completion_evidence: Debrief names the next test or proposal, accountable owner and decision date.
